name: GL_CROSS_VALIDATION_RULES_INT
description: This table is an interface table used to load cross-validation rules into the application.

columns.name: GROUP_NUMBER
columns.description: Cross-validation rule interface group identifier.

columns.name: ROW_NUMBER
columns.description: Cross-validation rule interface row number.

columns.name: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_CODE
columns.description: The chart of accounts structure code for which cross-validation rules are being imported.

columns.name: RULE_CODE
columns.description: The name of the cross-validation rule for which rules are being imported.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The description of the cross-validation rule.

columns.name: IMPORT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: The action that the import process must perform. Valid values are INSERT and DELETE.

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Earliest date on which this cross-validation rule is valid.

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Latest date on which this cross-validation rule is valid.

columns.name: RULE_ERROR_MESSAGE_TEXT
columns.description: The user-defined error message for a cross-validation rule violation.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the cross-validation rule is available for use.

columns.name: CONDITION_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Segment column that contains the condition filter segment used in the cross-validation rule.

columns.name: CONDITION_OPERATOR_NAME
columns.description: Segment operator for the condition filter segment of the cross-validation rule.

columns.name: CONDITION_VALUES
columns.description: Segment values for the condition filter segment of the cross-validation rule.

columns.name: VALIDATION_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Segment column that contains the validation filter segment used in the cross-validation rule.

columns.name: VALIDATION_OPERATOR_NAME
columns.description: Segment operator for the validation filter segment of the cross-validation rule.

columns.name: VALIDATION_VALUES
columns.description: Segment values for the validation filter segment of the cross-validation rule.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates the import status of the cross-validation rule. Valid values are NEW, SUCCESS, and ERROR.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: The error message of the cross-validation rule that could not be imported. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row. This column is used in internal processing only.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
